title: How to Deploy What Cursor or Claude Code Builds: The Full-Stack Infrastructure Guide
summary: Cursor and Claude Code write the code. Here's how to actually deploy it — database, auth, and hosting sorted in 2 minutes with Blink Cloud. No DevOps needed.
body_markdown: The blink.new app builder is a browser-based interface for building apps through conversation. Blink Cloud is the infrastructure layer — database, auth, storage, deploy — accessible via MCP from any coding agent including Cursor and Claude Code. They share the same backend; you choose which front end to use.
